description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库、准备 Pointwise RL 数据、启动 MIND Pointwise Yes/No RL 训练

commands.name: 删除旧的 MiniOneRec 目录
准备 Pointwise RL 训练数据
commands.description: 生成 Pointwise RL 训练所需的 parquet 数据（neg_ratio 编入文件名防止使用过期数据）
commands.command: NEG_RATIO_TAG=$(echo "{neg_ratio}" | tr '.' 'p') && TRAIN_PARQUET={data_root}/train/rl_pointwise_neg${NEG_RATIO_TAG}_train.parquet && if [ "{regenerate_data}" = "1" ] || [ ! -f "$TRAIN_PARQUET" ]; then echo "=== 生成训练 parquet: $TRAIN_PARQUET ===" && ABSTRACT_FLAG=$([ "{use_abstract}" = "1" ] && echo "--use_abstract" || echo "") && python src/prepare_mind_rl_pointwise.py --behaviors_path {data_root}/train/behaviors.tsv --news_path {data_root}/train/news.tsv --output_parquet $TRAIN_PARQUET --max_history {max_history} --neg_ratio {neg_ratio} $ABSTRACT_FLAG; else echo "=== 复用已有训练 parquet: $TRAIN_PARQUET ==="; fi

commands.name: 准备 Pointwise RL 评估数据
commands.description: 生成 Pointwise RL 评估所需的 parquet 数据
commands.command: NEG_RATIO_TAG=$(echo "{neg_ratio}" | tr '.' 'p') && DEV_PARQUET={data_root}/dev/rl_pointwise_neg${NEG_RATIO_TAG}_dev.parquet && if [ "{regenerate_data}" = "1" ] || [ ! -f "$DEV_PARQUET" ]; then echo "=== 生成评估 parquet: $DEV_PARQUET ===" && ABSTRACT_FLAG=$([ "{use_abstract}" = "1" ] && echo "--use_abstract" || echo "") && python src/prepare_mind_rl_pointwise.py --behaviors_path {data_root}/dev/behaviors.tsv --news_path {data_root}/dev/news.tsv --output_parquet $DEV_PARQUET --max_history {max_history} --neg_ratio {neg_ratio} $ABSTRACT_FLAG --max_samples 5000; else echo "=== 复用已有评估 parquet: $DEV_PARQUET ==="; fi

commands.name: 启动 Pointwise RL 训练
commands.description: 运行 Pointwise Yes/No RL 训练
commands.command: NEG_RATIO_TAG=$(echo "{neg_ratio}" | tr '.' 'p') && SFT_MODEL_PATH={sft_model} MIND_ROOT={data_root} MIND_SIZE=$(echo {data_root} | grep -q 'large' && echo 'large' || echo 'small') USE_ABSTRACT={use_abstract} REWARD_TYPE={reward_type} TOTAL_EPOCHS={total_epochs} LEARNING_RATE={learning_rate} TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE={train_batch_size} KL_LOSS_COEF={kl_loss_coef} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} NEG_RATIO={neg_ratio} NUM_GENERATIONS={num_generations} MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH={max_prompt_length} MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH={max_response_length} OUTPUT_DIR={output_root}/rl_mind_pointwise_$(echo {data_root} | grep -q 'large' && echo 'large' || echo 'small')_$(basename {sft_model})_{reward_type} TRAIN_PARQUET={data_root}/train/rl_pointwise_neg${NEG_RATIO_TAG}_train.parquet DEV_PARQUET={data_root}/dev/rl_pointwise_neg${NEG_RATIO_TAG}_dev.parquet bash scripts/rl_mind_pointwise.sh

commands.name: 运行模型评估
commands.description: 训练完成后自动评估模型（如果 run_eval=1）
commands.command: if [ "{run_eval}" = "1" ]; then RL_OUTPUT_DIR={output_root}/rl_mind_pointwise_$(echo {data_root} | grep -q 'large' && echo 'large' || echo 'small')_$(basename {sft_model})_{reward_type} && if [ -d "$RL_OUTPUT_DIR/final_checkpoint" ]; then echo "=== 开始模型评估 ===" && mkdir -p $RL_OUTPUT_DIR/eval_results && MIND_SIZE=$(echo {data_root} | grep -q 'large' && echo 'large' || echo 'small') && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE=$MIND_SIZE MIND_ROOT={data_root} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} USE_ABSTRACT={use_abstract} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE=8 OUTPUT_FILE=$RL_OUTPUT_DIR/eval_results/{eval_split}_pointwise_predictions.txt bash scripts/eval_mind_pointwise.sh $RL_OUTPUT_DIR/final_checkpoint {eval_split} && echo "=== 评估结果已保存到 $RL_OUTPUT_DIR/eval_results/ ==="; else echo "ERROR: RL checkpoint not found at $RL_OUTPUT_DIR/final_checkpoint"; exit 1; fi; else echo '=== 跳过评估 (run_eval=0) ==='; fi

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.description: 保持容器运行以便进入调试
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行，可通过 AML Portal 进入容器调试 ===' && sleep infinity
